title: Book Three · Chapter 107: Leo's Answer
story:
Ronan sent his letter ten days ago. Today, Leo's reply arrives.

It is Friday afternoon. Ronan puts his school bag down before he opens the envelope.

Leo starts with the journey home. The bus reached the other city that Saturday afternoon. His aunt needed two days to put away all the food from the grandmother.

Then come the counts.

I agree. Forty-one yuan, ten good books, two damaged books, and two bags. We can finish the shared sale now.

Ronan lays the letter beside his own list. Every number is the same.

Leo wants the railway stories and the garden book. He also chooses three B stories from the titles Ronan sent. That leaves five B books for Ronan.

One cloth bag will go with each group.

For the cash, Leo agrees to equal halves. He asks Ronan to give his half to his grandmother. He has written to her about it. She can say where to put the bag.

Ronan reads that part twice. Then he reaches the damaged books.

You can give those pages to Mr Qiu as waste paper, if he wants them. He needs to know the stories are incomplete. The big old sale card can go too.

Ronan puts a small mark beside the line. He has not handed those things over yet.

The last part of Leo's letter is about school. He has a new desk away from the window. His friend says the view is better there. He can see the board.

Ronan smiles. He can hear Leo's voice in that sentence.

He turns the sheet over to look for more. Leo has drawn a small window near his name. The board is beside it, much larger than the window.

Ronan laughs aloud.

Mum looks through the door.

“What is funny?”

“The view from his desk.”

He shows her the drawing. She looks at the huge board.

“Plenty to look at.”

Ronan puts the letter flat again. He wants to answer that part too. He will write about the handover after it is done.

Mum comes in with a finished coat.

“What does he say about the books?”

“He agrees.”

“Then you can finish the count.”

Ronan nods. He puts the ten good books on the table and checks the five titles for Leo.

The two L books go together. Three B stories go beside them. The other five B books stay in the second group.

He does not put cash in either bag tonight. He wants Leo's grandmother to see the count when he comes tomorrow.

Before dinner, he tells Mr Qiu about the two incomplete books and the used large card.

“For wrapping paper?” Mr Qiu asks.

“Only that.”

Mr Qiu looks at one torn edge and nods. He can use the whole pages around small pencil bundles.

“Bring them on Monday,” he says. “I have room in the paper box.”

Ronan writes Monday beside that line. Then he puts the cash, the book list, and Leo's reply together.

Outside, Dad comes through the green door after work. Ronan moves his two groups of books away from the supper space before he goes to greet him.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

equal halves＝相等的两半；waste paper＝废纸；incomplete＝不完整的；bundle＝扎好的一小束。

## 理解问题

1. Leo的回信是否真实到达后才同意结算？他选了哪五本书？
2. 两本问题书和大价牌打算怎样处理？本章是否已经交给Mr Qiu？

## 读句子

**One cloth bag will go with each group.**

拆开看：One cloth bag / will go / with each group.

一个布袋／会跟着／每组五本书各配一个。
